# Avalanche Cross-Chain Bridge

> Avalanche Cross-Chain Bridge is a non-custodial interface for moving tokens from Ethereum and other chains to the Avalanche C-Chain and back. Routes use lock-and-mint or liquidity bridges, and gas on Avalanche is paid in AVAX. You connect your own wallet and sign every transaction.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- Bridged assets usually arrive on the Avalanche C-Chain, the EVM-compatible chain.
- Lock-and-mint bridges mint a wrapped token on Avalanche; liquidity bridges pay out from a destination pool.
- Gas on the C-Chain is paid in AVAX, so keep a small balance for transactions after bridging.
- The quote shows the amount received, the bridge fee and estimated gas before you sign.
- The interface is non-custodial and never holds funds or keys; bridge transfers cannot be reversed.
